display_name: DFD And STRIDE Core With Threat Workbench

model._note: Persona-cell workbench job (ADR-0019): the DFD/STRIDE core and the join are deterministic Python; the model work is done by the threat-workbench-* cell templates (claude-sonnet-5/high), each resolved from its own template through a C01 pool. This entry describes the job; it is not a separate dispatch pin.

required: exact F02 evidence assembly and dereferenced artifact cited through F03
accepted 02-code-index code-index.json (pinned for the workbench cells; serves the code_* query tools)

workbench_enabled.description: Run the ADR-0008/0019 threat-workbench persona cells after the deterministic DFD/STRIDE core. Off: the deterministic core publishes alone and every cell is recorded omitted.

workbench_budget_class.description: ADR-0008 budget class (probe, standard, deep); selects the concurrent-cell limit below.

workbench_concurrent_cells_probe.description: Workbench cells run at once under the probe budget class (ADR-0008 Decision 6).

workbench_concurrent_cells_standard.description: Workbench cells run at once under the standard budget class (ADR-0008 Decision 6).

workbench_concurrent_cells_deep.description: Workbench cells run at once under the deep budget class (ADR-0008 Decision 6).

workbench_cell_budget.description: Persona budget tier (probe, standard, full) for each workbench cell invocation.

workbench_wave_timeout_seconds.description: Wait-all limit for one workbench wave pool.
workbench_wave_timeout_seconds.scale: Cells run concurrently; raise with slow models, not with target size (lookup tools keep calls small).

workbench_pin_target_source.description: Pin every target file as a readable input of each cell (lookup mode serves them), so cells can cite code by path and line.
workbench_pin_target_source.scale: Pool specs grow with file count: ~6,100 files for freeciv21. Turn off at engine scale; cells then cite menu evidence only.

workbench_menu_pin_max_bytes.description: Total bytes of supporting-evidence menu files pinned for the cells; later files are listed unpinned.
workbench_menu_pin_max_bytes.scale: Grows with evidence volume; lookup tools serve pinned files, so this bounds hashing, not the prompt.

workbench_menu_file_pin_max_bytes.description: Largest single menu file pinned for the cells.

workbench_records_per_cell_max.description: Most records of one family the join takes from one cell reply; the rest is recorded as a gap.
